verdict_basis: The corrected treatment recovers terminal retention from 0/16 (D2 two-stage) to 2/16 with two independently source-supported valuable facts (four-surface proven) and bounded low-value persistence (2 nonvaluable episodes, both duplicate-family representatives; no boilerplate episodes). However 14/16 valuable targets are still lost, and the dominant loss stage is the independent reviewer: 11 REVIEW_DEFER (7 repetition_candidate, 6 not_substantive, 1 review_uncertain) plus 3 targets whose only candidate was not the target's claim. The repetition_candidate deferrals are order-dependent: within a drain pass the nonvaluable sibling of a defect family is ACCEPTed first and then anchors the family, causing the valuable sibling to be REVIEWed as a repetition. A handful of favorable model decisions alone is not adequate per the contract; retention has not yet recovered materially across independently supported technical facts.
